pages.text: Pipes for $(l)liquids$(): water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, Acid and the liquids of other mods. Use them to bring water from a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l) to a $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)Coolant Mixer$(/l), an $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l) or a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l), and acid to the $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l). Gases (biogas, methane, Steam) need a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l). Their band is $(l)blue$().

$(li)Pipes $(l)connect by themselves$() to other Liquid Pipes and to any block that holds fluids, from CyberFarm or from any other mod.$(br)$(li)They $(l)store nothing$(): what a machine pushes in goes straight to the blocks on the network, which take turns.
$(li)From each machine pushing into it, up to $(l)1,000 mB/t$() enters the network through a basic pipe, $(l)4,000$() through an Advanced one and $(l)16,000$() through an Elite one.
$(li)All tiers join into one network, but a Liquid Pipe $(l)never joins a Gas Pipe$(): the water line into a reactor and the steam line out of it can run side by side.
